div.head: I Atr 1.2
div.ab: Gyf se hlaford sæcge þæt him naðor ne burste ne að ne ordal syððan þæt gemot wæs æt Bromdune, nime se hlaford him twegen getreowa ðegenas innan ðam hundrede ⁊ swerian þæt him næfre að ne burste ne he ðeofgyld ne gulde—buton he ðone gerefan hæbbe ðe ðæs wyrðe sy þe þæt don mæge.

If his lord asserts that he (the accused) has failed neither in oath nor in ordeal since the assembly was held at Bromdun, he (the lord) shall choose two trustworthy thegns within the hundred, and they shall swear that neither has his oath ever failed nor has he been convicted of stealing—unless the lord have a reeve who is qualified to discharge his duty.

Gif se hlaford sæcge, þæt him naðer ne burste ne að ne ordal, syððan þæt gemot wæs æt Bromdune, nime se hlaford him twegen getreowa þegenas innan þam hundrede, ⁊ swerian, þæt him næfre að ne burste, ne he þeofgyld ne gulde—butan he þone gerefan hæbbe, þe þæs wyrðe sy, þe þæt don mæge.
